conclusion: A real RX3000 sample is independently confirmed by its private read-only runtime capture; preflight and captured ENV select RX3000 product configuration. A salted-HMAC-only comparison confirms the OTA config serial equals the sample ENV manucode without disclosing either value. Offline UBI reconstruction proves the captured active kernel Image is byte-identical to archived NX30 R010, so the configured gwVer=NX30V100R010 is corroborated by actual runtime bytes. The retained official API response for this identity/current-version pair returns NX30V100R012, and the RX-named 31,981,568-byte R012 payload hash exactly matches the separately verified NX30 R012 package. Its NX30/D019 rootfs contains RX3000 ProductNumber=98 configuration matching the captured runtime selector. Treat the image as a verified shared-source payload for RX and NX contexts, not a distinct RX binary; do not infer support/qualification for all RX board classes or ABCD combinations.
